purpose: Map robot marker design alternatives; not runtime or CAD specifications

variants.name: 01-top-view
variants.title: 01 · 탑뷰 마커
variants.details: Design A, recommended: a compact top-down robot footprint, approximately 34 by 42 CSS pixels on the map, aligned to a clear forward direction. A clean warm-white rectangular body with very subtly rounded corners, navy 1.5px contour, four tiny graphite wheel tabs, simplified folded-arm geometry visible from above, and one short teal forward-direction notch. No cartoon facial features, no 3D mast protruding tall, no backing container. A tiny blue status dot beside the silhouette is allowed, but not a surrounding circle. Default state has no permanent name label. In the lower specimen strip, show the default compact marker and an optional selected state with a small thin rectangular 'cleany-01 · 대기' label beside it. Exact main title '01 · 탑뷰 마커'. Short supporting text '작은 면적 · 방향 식별'. The floor-plan marker should be genuinely small and refined.
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished landscape 1536x1024 design proposal board for the Cleany Korean robot operations dashboard. Reference image 1 is the real 18F dashboard and map: preserve the recognizable floor plan, D-HUB desk layout, room walls, navigation, neutral white/navy/teal styling, and left roster. Reference image 2 supplies the physical Cleany robot identity: pale rectangular enclosure, folded arms and a narrow camera mast, small dark wheels. This is a map-marker design study, NOT a redesign of the robot-management detail page.
Composition: upper 75% is the actual dashboard map context with ONE small replacement robot marker near the aisle below the D-HUB desks; the map should stay dominant. Lower 25% is a clearly separated editorial specimen strip showing an enlarged view of that SAME marker plus a realistic small-size specimen. The enlarged specimen is OUTSIDE the app viewport, never an oversized icon on the map. Keep the dashboard screenshot flat, no device frame or browser chrome. Remove pink browser extension widgets. Do not invent telemetry, additional robots, routes or sensor data. Keep battery/location described as unconnected where shown. Remove the existing blue circular frame and glow completely. No circles, discs, rings, locator halos or giant drop shadows around the robot. Crisp professional UI, legible restrained Korean, accurate clean proportions. Clearly label the board as a design concept.

variants.name: 02-mini-3d
variants.title: 02 · 미니 3D
variants.details: Design B: use a background-free miniature 3D sticker of the actual Cleany robot in reference 2, approximately 42 by 48 CSS pixels on the map. Keep the recognizable pale box enclosure, folded arms, slim upright camera mast and dark wheels. Simplify tiny mechanical seams, highlight clean enclosure planes, produce a cohesive finished product render with neutral lighting. Crisp silhouette and a subtle white keyline ensure visibility against floor-plan strokes. Only a very short soft contact shadow directly under the wheels, no circular or square tile, no glowing halo. A small blue status dot is offset beside the body. Default state has no text plate; show the selected-state thin rectangular 'cleany-01 · 대기' tag only in the lower specimen strip. Exact main title '02 · 미니 3D'. Short supporting text '실제 형상 · 배경 제거'. Do not enlarge the on-map robot into a product hero.

variants.name: 03-face-tag
variants.title: 03 · 얼굴과 이름택
variants.details: Design C: a compact, polished Cleany face mark based on the existing brand face visible on the original map and top navigation: navy rounded-square face outline, two small eyes, friendly restrained expression, tiny yellow side accent. Approximately 28 by 28 CSS pixels on the map. The face itself is the entire marker: remove the outer blue circular frame and any additional backing badge. Use consistent 1.5px strokes and a small blue status dot tucked beside one corner. Default state shows only the face. The lower specimen strip additionally shows a selected state with a compact horizontal label 'cleany-01 · 대기', subtle light rectangular background with 4px corners and no enclosing pill around the icon. Make the selected label read as a lightweight UI annotation, not a large card. Exact main title '03 · 얼굴과 이름택'. Short supporting text '빠른 식별 · 선택 시 정보'. The main map still uses the default small face without a permanent label.
